command: gate-remote -- env LLV_OWNED_RUN_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000 bash scripts/gate-slot.sh bash -c "$CHECK_SCRIPT"

commandSources.focusedFinalRerun:
set -uo pipefail
result=0
mkdir -p .artifacts/s6-fix
: > .artifacts/s6-fix/status.tsv
run_check() {
  name=$1; shift
  "$@" 2>&1 | tee ".artifacts/s6-fix/$name.log"
  last_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  printf 'CHECK_EXIT %s %s\n' "$name" "$last_code"
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$last_code" >> .artifacts/s6-fix/status.tsv
  if [ "$last_code" -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
}
unset LLV_KANBAN_BROWSER_TEST LLV_SWIPE_BROWSER_TEST
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR/media-bin"
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$TMPDIR/media-bin/ffmpeg"

export PATH="$TMPDIR/media-bin:$PATH"
